status: isolated prototype validated; not integrated or committed
implementation: On-demand successful directory snapshots and attribute queries expire after 3 seconds; FUSE entry and attr timeout 1 second.
Only directories already enumerated are refreshed on getattr; no recursive/background tree scan.
Detected name/object-ID differences update local directory change timestamp, including changes within one phone timestamp second.
Readdir uses stable inode-based cookies sorted by cookie, rather than byte offsets in a name-sorted encoded cache.
Fresh metadata is assembled before publishing directory cache; active Android edits retain acknowledged local sizes.
Independent NFS export support and lookup . / .. let the kernel reconstruct existing file handles after inode eviction.
ReadDir diagnostic now includes inode and offset.

finder_validation.latency: not precisely measured; observed via accessibility snapshots after user confirmations

regression_correction: First pagination assertion counted only 240 user files; macOS also created 240 AppleDouble files. Corrected enumeration had 480 unique entries, no missing originals.

directory_errors.classification: same previously observed inaccessible phone directory; not Download or regression directory

limits: No measured end-to-end Finder refresh SLA; NFS/Finder caches still apply
No claim of concurrent host/phone editing conflict resolution or full file-content cache coherence
No sustained large-video performance comparison this round
Storage hotplug within one session not implemented; storage inode mapping fixed for the session
